content.text: write a pi extension that shows my codex weekly usage in footer

Assumption: the footer should use your existing Codex/OpenAI login and display the weekly quota percentage plus reset time. I’ll inspect Pi’s extension/footer APIs and your current Pi configuration, then implement the smallest extension and validate it without applying the Nix config.

Plan:
1. Find the supported footer/status API and existing extension layout.
2. Identify how Codex usage/auth can be read locally.
3. Add the extension and config wiring.
4. Run repository validation.

input.command: find . -maxdepth 5 -iname '*pi*' -o -path '*/extensions/*' | sort | head -200 && printf '\n--- relevant refs ---\n' && rg -n "piPackages|extensions|footer|status" modules hosts flake.nix 2>/dev/null | head -250
